main_character.name: Toby Turtle
main_character.appearance: Toby is a young sea turtle with a rounded teal-green shell patterned in soft swirls, gentle brown eyes, and smooth blue-green flippers. He has a calm, unhurried expression.

supporting_characters.name: Pip Bird
supporting_characters.appearance: A tiny fluffy bird with soft brown feathers and a little yellow beak.
supporting_characters.role: Needs help getting back to its nest and staying safe.

cover.prompt: Pixar-quality 3D illustration of Toby Turtle, a young sea turtle with a rounded teal-green shell patterned in soft swirls, gentle brown eyes, and smooth blue-green flippers, carefully watching over a tiny fluffy bird with soft brown feathers and a little yellow beak. They are at the edge of Crystal Lake, with green reeds nearby. Soft lighting, pastel colours, children's book illustration, vertical composition, Instagram friendly. Reserve the lower third for title placement.
cover.setting: Edge of Crystal Lake, green reeds
cover.visual_action: Toby Turtle watching over a tiny bird

slides.title: A Sunny Morning
slides.text: Toby Turtle loved Crystal Lake. The morning sun made the water sparkle. He watched dragonflies zip by. Many colourful birds sang happy songs from the green trees. Toby smiled. He loved listening to them. "Slow and steady discovers wonders!" he thought. He felt calm and happy.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Toby at his favourite place, Crystal Lake, setting a peaceful morning scene with birdsong.

slides.title: A Tiny Sound
slides.text: Suddenly, Toby heard a soft, sad sound. "Peep, peep," it went again. Toby looked very carefully. He saw a tiny brown bird on the ground, near a big tree. It was little Pip Bird! Pip Bird looked lost and scared. It was too small to fly back up.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce the challenge: Toby finds a lost baby bird (Pip Bird) on the ground.

slides.title: Needing Help
slides.text: Pip Bird flapped its tiny wings. It tried to jump, but it could not fly high. Its nest was way up, safe in a tall tree branch. Toby knew Pip Bird needed help to stay safe. He slowly, gently moved his big shell closer. Toby wanted to keep Pip Bird warm.
slides.speaker_notes: Highlight Pip Bird's predicament and Toby's gentle, patient nature in approaching to help.

slides.title: A Safe Place
slides.text: Toby found a big, wide green leaf. He carefully nudged Pip Bird onto the soft leaf. Then he moved the leaf and Pip Bird under a safe, shady bush. Now Pip Bird was hidden and warm from the sun. Toby stayed nearby, watching. He hoped Pip Bird's mummy would come soon.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Toby's creative solution, using natural elements to create a safe spot for the bird.

slides.title: Happy Ending
slides.text: Soon, Mummy Bird flew down from the tree! She saw her baby, Pip Bird, safe under the bush. She chirped a loud, happy song. Toby felt very good inside. He was so happy to help a friend. He loved protecting nature. "Slow and steady discovers wonders!" he whispered softly.
slides.speaker_notes: Conclude with the happy reunion and Toby's positive emotional reflection on helping and protecting nature.

instagram.caption: What sound did Toby Turtle hear by the lake? One sunny morning, Toby was enjoying the peaceful Crystal Lake. But then, a soft "Peep, peep" caught his ear! He looked closely and found tiny Pip Bird on the ground, far from its nest. Pip Bird was too small to fly back up. Toby, with his kind heart and steady movements, knew just what to do to keep Pip Bird safe. This heartwarming tale teaches children about kindness, looking out for little creatures, and the joy of protecting our beautiful nature. 📚 Save this story for your next reading time.
